verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              ततो ब्रह्मर्षयः सर्वे सिद्धा देवर्षयस्तथा। हव्यवाहं पुरस्कृत्य ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः॥१॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : Thereupon the Brahmarshis, the Siddhas, the celestials, saints, with Havyavaha as their spokesman, sought the protection of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निरुवाच।
              योऽसौ विश्रवसः पुत्रो दशग्रीवो महाबलः। अवध्यो वरदानेन कृतो भगवता पुरा॥२॥
verses.english: The highly powerful, ten-headed son of Vishrava cannot be slain for the boon, that was given him before by you.

verses.sanskrit: स बाधते प्रजाः सर्वा विप्रकारैर्महाबलः। ततो नस्त्रातु भगवान्नान्यस्त्राता हि विद्यते॥३॥
verses.english: The mighty powerful one is oppressing the creatures in every possible way; therefore save us, O lord; there is none else except you to save us.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              न स देवासुरैः शक्यो युद्धे जेतुं विभावसो। विहितं तत्र यत् कार्यमभितस्तस्य निग्रहः॥४॥
verses.english: Brahma said: O Vibhavasu, he cannot slain in battle either by the celestials or the Asuras I have already ordained what is necessary for this purpose. But his death is near.

verses.sanskrit: तदर्थमवतीर्णोऽसौ मन्नियोगाच्चतुर्भुजः। विष्णुः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः स तत् कर्म करिष्यति॥५॥
verses.english: For this purpose and at my command the four-headed god has already been incarnated; Vishnu, the foremost of repressors, shall accomplish this.

verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              पितामहस्ततस्तेषां सन्निधौ शक्रमब्रवीत्। सर्वैर्देवगणैः सार्धं सम्भव त्वं महीतले॥६॥
verses.english: In their presence then the Grandfather said to Shakra, “You also take your birth on earth, with all these celestials.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोः सहायानृक्षीषु वानरीषु च सर्वशः। जनयध्वं सुतान् वीरान् कामरूबलान्वितान्॥७॥
verses.english: You all beget on monkeys and bears heroic and powerful sons capable of assuring forms at will to help Vishnu."

verses.sanskrit: ततो भागानुभागेन देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। अवतर्तुं महीं सर्वे मन्त्रयामासुरञ्जसा॥८॥
verses.english: At this, the celestial, the Gandharvas and the Danavas quickly assembled to consult as to how they should he born on earth according to their respective parts.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां समक्षं गन्धर्वीं दुन्दुभीं नाम नामतः। शशास वरदो देवो गच्छ कार्यार्थसिद्धये॥९॥
verses.english: In their presence the Deity, conferring boons commanded a Gandharvi named Dundubhi saying, “Go there for accomplishing this object.”

verses.sanskrit: पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा गन्धर्वी दुन्दुभी ततः। मन्थरा मानुषे लोके कुब्जा समभवत् तदा॥१०॥
verses.english: Hearing the words of Grandfather, Dundubhi became born on earth as the haunchbacked Manthara.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रप्रभृतयश्चैव सर्वे ते सुरसत्तमाः। वानरर्क्षवरस्त्रीषु जनयामासुरात्मजान्॥११॥
verses.english: And all the leading celestial, Shakra and others begot offspring on the wives of the foremost of monkeys and bears.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽन्ववर्तन् पज़्तॄन् सर्वे यशसा च बलेन च। भेत्तारो गिरिशृङ्गाणां सालतालशिलायुधाः॥१२॥
verses.english: They all took after their fathers, in strength and fame; they were capable of breaking down mountain summits and their weapons were trees of Shala and Tala.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रसंहननाः सर्वे सर्वे चौघबलास्तथा। कामवीर्यबलाश्चैव सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥१३॥
verses.english: Their bodies were as hard as adamant and they were all endued with very great strength; they were all skilled in the art of warfare and could summon any amount of strength at their will.

verses.sanskrit: नागायुतसमप्राणा वायुवेगसमा जवे। यत्रेच्छकनिवासाश्च केचिदत्र वनौकसः॥१४॥
verses.english: They were gifted with the strength of an Ayuta elephants and were like the wind in speed; some of them lived wherever they liked; others lived in woods.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विधाय तत् सर्वं भगवाँल्लोकभावनः। मन्थरां बोधयामास यद्यत् कार्यं यथा यथा॥१५॥
verses.english: Having ordained all this the worshipful creator instructed Manthara as to what she should do.
verses.bhavadeepa: यत्रेच्छा तत्रैव निवासो येषां ते यत्रेच्छकनिवासाः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: सा तद्वचः समाज्ञाय तथा चक्रे मनोजवा। इतश्चेतश्च गच्छन्ती वैरसन्धुक्षणे रता॥१६॥
verses.english: Understanding his words she, quick as thought, did accordingly. She moved about here and there fanning quarrels.
